# Google Ads Keywords for Accountants: Full List by Service

[![Mirza Lacevic, CEO and Google Ads Strategist at Clickem](https://clickem.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/screenshot-1787861704560-1.png)](https://clickem.io/author/mirza-lacevic/)

## [Mirza Lacevic](https://clickem.io/author/mirza-lacevic/)

October 22, 2026

![Calculator on a desk next to printed charts, a keyboard and a laptop](https://clickem.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/accountant-google-ads-keywords-1024x576.jpg)

The best Google Ads keywords for accountants name a service and a buyer, such as “bookkeeping services for small business”, “tax accountant near me” or “fractional CFO for startups”. Group keywords by service line (bookkeeping, tax, CFO and advisory, payroll, audit), start with exact and phrase match, and block job, course, software and do-it-yourself searches before the first click.

**In short:**

*   Build one ad group per service, and one campaign per service line that has its own budget and value, so a bookkeeping retainer is never bid like a one-off tax return.
*   Keywords that pair a service with a place (“\[city\]”, “near me”) or a buyer (“for contractors”, “for startups”) signal hiring intent; “how to”, “what is”, “salary” and “course” signal the opposite.
*   Google’s own help says negative keywords don’t match close variants, so plurals and misspellings of every negative have to be added by hand.
*   The Uniform Accountancy Act, the model law that state accountancy laws largely follow, reserves the titles “certified public accountant” and “CPA” for licensees, so bid on CPA terms only if you hold the license.
*   A responsive search ad takes up to 15 headlines of 30 characters each, which is enough to write service-specific copy for every ad group below.

This is the keyword build for an accounting practice. For strategy, retainer value and seasonality, read our [complete guide to Google Ads for accountants](https://clickem.io/google-ads-for-accountants-a-complete-guide-to-growing-your-practice/); for tax season specifically, see [Google Ads for tax preparers](https://clickem.io/google-ads-for-tax-preparers/). Below are the keyword lists by service, the negatives, the match types and six sample ad groups you can copy.

## How should accountants organize Google Ads keywords?

By service first, then by intent. Each service line has a different client value, landing page and close rate, and mixing them in one ad group means one ad and one bid for very different buyers.

Within each service, sort keywords into three intent levels before you add them to the account.

| Intent level | Signal words | Example | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ready to hire | near me, \[city\], services, firm, company, outsourced, hire, for \[business type\] | outsourced bookkeeping for restaurants | Core keywords. Exact and phrase match, full bids. |
| Comparing | cost, pricing, fees, best, vs, reviews, switch | bookkeeping services cost per month | Keep, with a landing page that shows prices or ranges. Lower bids. |
| Learning or doing it themselves | how to, what is, template, example, course, salary, jobs, free, software | how to do bookkeeping for a small business | Negative keywords. These rarely become clients. |

What this means for you: the same service word (“bookkeeping”) appears in all three rows. The modifier around it decides whether you want the click, so your negatives should target modifiers, not the service itself.

## Which Google Ads keywords should accountants use for each service?

The lists below are starting points, not volume-ranked lists. Check each term’s search volume and suggested bid for your own cities in Google Keyword Planner before you launch, because demand for accounting services varies a lot by market.

### Bookkeeping keywords

*   bookkeeping services near me
*   bookkeeping services \[city\]
*   small business bookkeeping services
*   outsourced bookkeeping services
*   monthly bookkeeping services
*   virtual bookkeeping services
*   catch up bookkeeping
*   bookkeeping cleanup services
*   quickbooks bookkeeper near me
*   bookkeeper for \[contractors, restaurants, ecommerce, real estate\]
*   bookkeeping services cost

Bookkeeping is the retainer most practices want, so give it its own campaign and budget. “Catch up” and “cleanup” searches are urgent, often after a missed deadline or a lender request, and deserve their own ad group and page.

### Tax keywords (business and personal)

*   tax accountant near me
*   tax accountant \[city\]
*   small business tax accountant
*   business tax preparation services
*   S corp tax preparation
*   partnership tax return preparer
*   tax planning for small business
*   tax preparation services near me
*   self employed tax accountant
*   tax accountant for \[rental property, crypto, expats, physicians\]

Split business tax from personal tax. Business tax clients usually become year-round clients, while many personal returns stay one-off. Seasonal pacing and compliance rules for tax ads are covered in our [tax preparer guide](https://clickem.io/google-ads-for-tax-preparers/).

### Fractional CFO and advisory keywords

*   fractional CFO services
*   fractional CFO for startups
*   outsourced CFO services
*   part time CFO
*   virtual CFO services
*   cash flow forecasting services
*   financial modeling for fundraising
*   CFO services for small business

Advisory searches are low in volume and high in value. Many of these buyers are not local, so test national or multi-state targeting here even if your bookkeeping and tax campaigns stay local.

### Payroll keywords

*   payroll services for small business
*   outsourced payroll services
*   payroll accountant near me
*   payroll services \[city\]
*   payroll and bookkeeping services
*   multi state payroll services

Payroll is the line most exposed to software. Many payroll searches are looking for a self-service app, so use a “payroll services” phrase core and lean heavily on negatives.

### Audit and assurance keywords

*   audit firm \[city\]
*   CPA audit services
*   financial statement audit
*   review engagement CPA
*   nonprofit audit services
*   401k plan audit
*   HOA audit
*   SOC 2 audit firm

In this article, we’ll explore how to maximize your accountancy firm’s online presence using Google Ads, from crafting your first ad to implementing advanced tracking techniques.

## Key Takeaways

*   Select targeted keywords and create compelling ad copy to enhance brand visibility and lead generation

## Crafting Your First Google Ad for Accountancy Services

You’ll need to focus on two key areas: selecting targeted keywords that resonate with your audience and creating compelling ad copy that drives conversions. By mastering these elements, you’ll enhance your **brand** visibility, improve **lead generation**, and guide potential clients to an optimized **landing page** that showcases your expertise.

### Selecting the Right Keywords for Your Audience

To [select the right keywords](https://www.cpasitesolutions.com/cpa-websites/2022/10/best-seo-accounting-keywords/) for your accountant [Google Ads advertising campaign](https://www.cpasitesolutions.com/ppc-for-accountants/), focus on terms that potential clients use when searching for tax and financial services. Consider phrases like “certified public accountant near me” or “tax preparation services” to attract qualified leads. Your digital marketing strategy should prioritize keywords with high search volume and a strong return on investment to maximize your ad’s effectiveness.

### Writing Compelling Ad Copy That Converts

Craft ad copy that speaks directly to your target audience‘s pain points and offers clear solutions. Highlight your unique selling propositions, such as expertise in tax preparation or financial planning, to stand out in the competitive landscape of [online advertising](https://www.cpasitesolutions.com/Local-Services-Ads-for-Accountants/). Use action-oriented language and include a strong call-to-action to drive conversions, keeping in mind that your cost per action should align with your overall marketing goals. Incorporate relevant keywords from your [keyword research](https://www.cpasitesolutions.com/cpa-websites/2024/03/keyword-research-for-accountants/) to improve ad visibility and relevance, but ensure the copy remains natural and engaging.

## Setting Up Successful Campaigns Within Budget

Setting up successful Google Ads campaigns for your accounting firm requires a strategic approach to budget allocation and campaign structure. By leveraging analytics and targeted advertising, you can maximize your reach while staying within your financial constraints. Focus on data-driven decisions to optimize your campaigns for bookkeeping and other accounting services, ensuring your ads appear in front of the right audience at the right time. Implement [conversion rate optimization techniques](https://www.cpasitesolutions.com/cpa-websites/2024/02/high-converting-accounting-websites/) to improve the performance of your ads and landing pages, ultimately driving more qualified leads to your firm.

### Defining Your Advertising Goals and Budget

Define clear advertising goals and establish a realistic budget for your accountant Google Ads campaign to maximize your firm’s visibility on Google search. Conduct thorough research to identify high-value phrases and keywords that align with your marketing objectives. Allocate your budget strategically across different campaigns, ensuring you have sufficient funds to compete effectively in your chosen market while maintaining a positive return on investment.

### Structuring Campaigns for Maximum Reach and Efficiency

Structure your accountant Google Ads campaigns for maximum reach and efficiency by segmenting your audience based on demographic targeting and specific services offered. Use performance indicators to track your campaign’s success and adjust your strategy accordingly. Leverage Google’s advertising tool to refine your targeting, improve brand awareness, and ensure a solid return on investment for your accounting firm.

Optimizing your Google Ads for higher conversion rates is crucial for maximizing your accounting firm’s visibility and return on investment. By leveraging tools like Google Analytics and working closely with a [Google Ads manager](https://www.cpasitesolutions.com/youget/accounting-marketing-support/), you can refine your campaigns to better reach your target audience. Your experience in the field, combined with data-driven strategies, will help you create ads that resonate with potential clients and drive conversions.
